qt: to the Commission Regina Doherty (PPE) Subject:

Will the Commission propose the development of an international protocol for responding to incidents involving frontier AI models, and seek to place this issue on the agenda of the G7, the G20 and the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, with a view to reaching agreement with international partners, including the United States and China?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (23.11.2026) The EU Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act1 is the first comprehensive legislation covering AI, including general-purpose AI models. Therefore, the EU is well-placed to respond to such incidents caused by such models. Internationally, the Commission, through the AI Office, stands ready to share its experience of the AI Act and the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice2, which supports the implementation of the AI Act. As announced by the President of the Commission in her State of the Union address, the Commission will work with like-minded partners such as Canada and others on model evaluation, verification, early warning and AI security. Canada and the EU agreed to enhance cooperation on cybersecurity, with particular attention to AI-enabled cyber threats. Furthermore, the Commission continues to be actively engaged with the global community in promoting these matters and the development and adoption of responsible AI innovation and the good governance of AI in all the relevant established fora, notably the UN, the Group of Seven (G7), the Group of Twenty (G20) and the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. The Commission is also actively exploring further ways of cooperating in order to mitigate risks and respond to incidents.
1 Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down

harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act), OJ L, 2024/1689, 12.7.2024. 2 https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/contents-code-gpai.
